selection.criteria: finite logMBH and positive catalog distance (Dist > 0)
selection.distance_model: BASS DR2 catalog distance in Mpc converted directly to light-years
selection.radius_model: Schwarzschild radius derived from BASS DR2 best black-hole mass
selection.scientific_scope: Hard-X-ray-selected AGNs represented by their central black-hole mass estimate; entries are not direct horizon detections.

source.name: BASS DR2 general hard-X-ray selected AGN properties
source.query:
SELECT
  "ID",
  "m_ID",
  "SWIFT",
  "CName",
  "RAJ2000",
  "DEJ2000",
  "Type",
  "z",
  "ztype",
  "Dist",
  "logMBH",
  "Method",
  "logLbol",
  "logEdd",
  "SimbadName"
FROM "J/ApJS/261/2/table9"
WHERE "logMBH" IS NOT NULL
  AND "Dist" > 0
ORDER BY "ID", "m_ID"
